verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page documents a global search launcher: press the Super key and type to search for what you need. It does not say what can be searched (files, apps, settings) or how fast results appear, so only the core of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that files, apps and settings are all searchable, evidence of instant results, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the launcher.
